rulings.reason: Neither reading fits: the early four-step crossover was not randomised ('not randomized design in the early application of PEEP strategy'), but the rest of the 16-h prone session was randomly allocated. GLM null says not reported; DeepSeek false ignores the randomised phase. Co-author decides how a partially randomised design is coded.
The paper makes no statement about balloon or strategy complications; silence is null (codebook), and false would imply complications occurred.
The paper gives no count of placement attempts; 38 is GLM's inference from 'after verification of correct placement', which carries no number.
No count of successful placements is reported; missing data are attributed to other causes (immediate proning, death, coronarography), so 38 is an inference.

The field records how filling volume was chosen: 'non-stress minimal volume implementation [20]' is minimal_volume; the Baydur test [19] is the placement check ('after verification of correct placement').

GLM's quote supports 38 enrolled, not analysed: Table 1 notes patients excluded for incomplete data (N 37 for most rows, 36 gas exchange, 31 Pga). Co-author decides whether population n_analysed is 38 (mortality) or 37 (Table 1 analysis).
